messages.author: 677663a1d6a801f5
messages.subject: death counts and corresponding age-groups with R-INLA Exceedance Probabilities
parts:
Hello, I have a data set that includes area (n=3,000), deaths, population, and 10 age groups. 
Using R-INLA, I have included the "age-group" as a factor covariate in the model (with Poisson distribution). After running the model, results summary indicate that there are 30,000 fitted values. 
However, when I try to map the exceedance probability of the relative risk (RR) above certain threshold (a=1.50), it gives me an error due to the difference in the matrix size (e.g., 3,000 vs. 30,000).
So, my question is, "Is there a way to aggregate the fitted values by area so that I can map the relative risk for each area?" I would greatly appreciate your assistance on this matter. 

Kind regards,
Jhon
